title: China launches AI-powered doctor kiosks diagnosing and dispensing #chinaai #aidoctor #healthtech
description: China deployed AI-powered doctor kiosks that diagnose patients in 60 seconds and dispense medicine instantly without an on-site doctor. Patients interact with the AI by describing symptoms and answering follow-up questions, while the data is reviewed remotely by a doctor to ensure accuracy. This innovation combines advanced AI diagnostics with automated pharmaceutical dispensing to increase access to healthcare in remote or underserved areas. The rollout of 1,000 kiosks aims to serve about 3 million people nationwide, marking a significant step in healthcare automation and digital medicine distribution. The adoption of such AI-driven solutions reflects broader trends in telemedicine and smart healthcare infrastructure, offering faster, more scalable medical services while helping to alleviate pressures on traditional healthcare systems. #ChinaAI #AIDoctor #HealthcareInnovation #Telemedicine #DigitalHealth #SmartHealthcare #MedicalAI #HealthTech #PharmacyAutomation #RemoteDiagnosis #AIKiosk #HealthTechChina #AutomatedMedicine #AIinMedicine #HealthcareAccess
